items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lou Honig, who supposedly, Eddie Harris and Johnny Griffin studied with at some point

ctx.x: . . . well, anyway, I did work out in the school, the inspiration from fellow “worker-outers” and things like that. But then, as I have mentioned a few times over the centuries, I got a coupon book with the clarinet that my parents very graciously bought for me, and this is unbelievable as I think of it, but I think that book had two hundred free lessons in it and the clarinet only cost about a hundred and fifty dollars and I had a good teacher, Lou Honig, who supposedly, Eddie Harris and Johnny Griffin studied…
Did he teach saxophone as well?
